svg.title: Suspected brain tumour: progressive symptoms and raised intracranial pressure prompt a contrast MRI; metastasis is treated by resection and radiation, a glioma by its grade (an enhancing high-grade glioma is treated at once, a non-enhancing low-grade glioma can be watched) and then its biomarkers set the prognosis, and primary CNS lymphoma is suspected in the immunosuppressed; further columns cover mass effect (raised pressure, then herniation) and paraneoplastic syndromes, the remote immune effects of cancer

svg.text: Could it be a brain TUMOUR? The red flag is PROGRESSIVE symptoms

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • neuro symptoms or signs progressing over days to weeks · SHORT history (weeks to a few months) = highly malignant ·

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: LONG (months or more) = benign or slow-growing

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • raised pressure: ↓ consciousness · headache, nausea, vomiting · Cushing response · papilledema (LATE) · herniation

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • headache: persistent, progressive, worse lying down and in the morning, wakes from sleep, worse with cough or Valsalva

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • focal deficit (weakness, sensory loss, dysphasia, gait, vision), insidious · mental status change: apathy, personality change

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: (mistaken for depression or dementia) · seizures, especially FOCAL

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • diagnosis: history · exam · CONTRAST MRI (gadolinium) = test of choice · CT only WITH contrast · TISSUE diagnosis

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • steroids for brain swelling · anti-seizure drugs only once there is a seizure · seizure → no driving, Ministry of Transportation
